requirements: R1: The backup container must execute its initialization scripts successfully without read-only filesystem permission errors.
R2: The orchestrator's health check must successfully connect to the backend service without connection refused errors.

slices.title: Repair runtime environment and health checks
slices.jtbd: When implementing the environment repair for this epic, I want to fix the backup container permissions and backend network resolution, so that the product successfully initializes without failure.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the docker-compose environment is launched
When the backup service initializes and the orchestrator health check probes the backend
Then the backup script executes without permission errors
And the backend responds successfully to the health check.
